class_name: 強調-副詞の強調-ノコトデ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1: author → mechanical attachment gate → cold review → fixes applied → gate re-run

patterns.usage_note: A booster welded onto an adverb of eventual attainment: やっとのことで says that the thing was managed only after a real struggle, and is far more vivid than a bare やっと. In practice the adverb is almost always やっと — ようやくのことで turns up in native prose but is rare — so treat this as a near-fixed phrase rather than a productive slot. The で drops before a copula (〜のはやっとのことだった), and the whole expression suits narration and lively speech alike.

examples.ruby: 大雨[おおあめ]の中[なか]、やっとのことで最終[さいしゅう]バスに間[ま]に合[あ]った。
examples.english: In the pouring rain, I only just managed to catch the last bus.

examples.ruby: 重[おも]い荷物[にもつ]を抱[かか]えて、やっとのことで階段[かいだん]を上[のぼ]りきった。
examples.english: Lugging the heavy bags, I struggled my way to the top of the stairs.

examples.ruby: 祖母[そぼ]は手[て]を震[ふる]わせながら、やっとのことで封筒[ふうとう]を開[あ]けた。
examples.english: Hands trembling, my grandmother finally got the envelope open.
